title: WWW
tagline: W.W.W or Warpcast Wallet Wrapped  is a frame that lets user generate a yearly recap of their on-chain actions.
description: W.W.W (Warpcast Wallet Wrapped) is a frame that generates a yearly recap of users' on-chain actions. WWW uses wallet information like meme coin holdings, Warpcast activity, and $DEGEN tipping to define 4 different user personalities. Users can mint these personalities as NFTs.
how_its_made: WWW was built using Frames.js for frame development and Next.js for front-end. It also uses Airstack's Frames SDK to get details from the interacting user like tokens held in their wallet on Base, $DEGEN tipping, and Farcaster engagement. We also used Pinata for Frame analytics.
